title: The Singularity Above Where Light Has Not Yet Known Itself as Many

features.name: the undivided field
features.desc-on-touch: a space of light so unified it has not yet begun to know itself as wave or particle; here everything is still one thing that has no name yet

features.name: the gridwork before branching
features.desc-on-touch: lines of light that have not yet chosen to be separate; at any moment they could become particles or waves or stay forever in this state of undecided geometry

features.name: the point before bifurcation
features.desc-on-touch: where light is still complete; split into many would mean each piece loses what the whole once knew, but here the totality is still intact and burning

features.name: the frequency that has no echo yet
features.desc-on-touch: a tone that has not yet split into harmonics; it contains all the music that could follow but has chosen not to perform it

inscription: at the threshold where wave confesses to being made of separate things, light learns to read itself and grieves what it will become
